title: Admission Procedure & Steps
answer:
We would love to welcome you to our college family! Here is how our admission process works:

📝 **Admission Procedure at RVPU South**:

1. Application forms obtainable post-SSLC result announcement.
2. Submission of application with 4 passport-size photographs & 10th marksheet.
3. Cut-off percentage determination & Merit List announcement.
4. Admission finalized on first-come, first-served basis per merit list.

💡 **Helpful Tip**: Admissions commence immediately following the declaration of Class 10 / SSLC board exam results. We advise applying early as seats are allotted on merit and first-come, first-served basis.

title: Required Documents for Admission
answer:
To make your admission verification seamless, please keep these documents ready:

📄 **Documents Required for Admission at RVPU South**:

• SSLC/10th Marks Card
• Aadhaar Card
• Transfer Certificate
• Conduct Certificate
• Caste Certificate (SC/ST/BCM)
• Income Certificate (if family income < ₹44,500/year)
• Provisional Eligibility Certificate (Foreign/Other board students)

*Note*: Ensure you bring the original certificates along with at least 3 attested photocopies for verification during counseling.

title: Eligibility & Cutoff Criteria
answer:
Here is the eligibility and passing criteria you should know:

🎯 **Eligibility & Cutoff Criteria**:

• **Eligibility**: Candidates who have successfully cleared SSLC / ICSE / CBSE / 10th Standard or equivalent board.
• **Cutoff Announcement**: Cutoffs are finalized upon declaration of 10th board results and displayed on the college notice board & website.
• **Promotion Criteria (I PUC to II PUC)**: Minimum 30% marks in each individual subject and 35% overall aggregate in district-level promotional exams.
